description: This file defines the NotificationScheduler object responsible for managing notification channels and scheduling or canceling alarms related to task reminders in an Android app.

methods.name: ensureNotificationChannel
methods.description: Creates a notification channel if it does not already exist, for devices running Android Oreo or higher.

methods.name: scheduleOrCancelForTask
methods.description: Schedules a notification alarm for a task if it has a future due date and is not completed; otherwise cancels any existing alarm for the task.

methods.name: cancelForTask
methods.description: Cancels any scheduled alarm for the specified task.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Sets an alarm for a given task at the specified trigger time, using exact timing methods depending on API level.

methods.name: pendingIntentForTask
methods.description: Creates and returns a PendingIntent for a specific task's alarm, used by AlarmManager.

methods.name: channelId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the notification channel used by this scheduler.
